rca_of_issues.contentNotFound_crash: spot-you/[id].tsx declared setContentNotFound(true) on line 567 and referenced contentNotFound on line 953, but never declared const [contentNotFound, setContentNotFound] = useState(false). This would throw ReferenceError: contentNotFound is not defined when: (1) any 404/410 SpotYou API response was received (setContentNotFound call), AND (2) when the component renders with !point and tries to evaluate contentNotFound. Fixed by adding the useState declaration at line 357 (after networkFailed state). Mitigation: Loading skeleton is shown first so the crash would only happen when the network response returns 404, not on initial render.
